messages.author: f43477bcb6489201
messages.subject: Can't parse message of type "REXP" because it is missing required fields: rclass
parts:
Hi,

I was trying to test Rhipe on my hadoop cluster of 5 nodes.(ubutntu
10.10, hadoop 0.20.203.0)

I installed Protocol Buffers(2.4.1) and Rhipe(0.66).

After installing, i succeeded in testing the following codes.

> library(Rhipe)
--------------------------------------------------------
| IMPORTANT: Before using Rhipe call rhinit() |
| Rhipe will not work or most probably crash |
--------------------------------------------------------
> rhinit(TRUE, TRUE)
> rhwrite(list(1,2,3),”/tmp/x”)
> rhread(“/tmp/x”)

so, i wrote 3 functions and executed job

There was an error msg(Can't parse message of type "REXP"~~~~~)

This is my functions and execution code


<--------------- the functions and execution code ----------------->

map<-expression({
words_vector<-unlist(strsplit(unlist(map.values)," "))
lapply(words_vector,function(i) rhcollect(i,1))
})


reduce<-expression(
pre={total <- 0},
reduce={total<-sum(total,unlist(reduce.values))},
post={rhcollect(reduce.key,total)}
)


job<-
rhmr(map=map,reduce=reduce,inout=c("text","sequence"),ifolder="/tmp/
input",ofolder="/tmp/output3",jobname="word_count")

rhex(job)

messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Can't parse message of type "REXP" because it is missing required fields: rclass
parts:
Hmm,

Instead of rhcollect(i,1) try, rhcollect("fooof",1)

My fear is that the words might not be serializing properly.

also, try reduce=rhoptions()$template$scalarsummer
same code as you wrote, but saves time.
